name: Nigel Sylvester x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 'Nigel Sylvester'
story_html: The Nigel Sylvester x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG gives Nigel Sylvester, a pro rider from Queens, New York, a high-top AJ1 in cream leather showcasing a worn-in aesthetic. Sylvester prefers the Air Jordan 1 when cruising around on his BMX, and the distressed shoe mimics natural scuffs and abrasions from mastering tricks. Pre-scuffed markings can be found on the toe and heel, while a mini-Swoosh can be found near the front toe of the shoe, a first for the Air Jordan 1.
